title: [GMCP 203.030.04] Adversarial and failure behavior: Supply-chain integrity and server/package trust
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-030-04. Close validation, authorization, isolation, privacy, bounded-resource, cancellation, concurrency, crash, retry, rollback, and recovery behavior. Add deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures derived from the vector threat model. Vector outcome: Every install resolves immutable package identity, source, version, digest, signature/provenance, license, SBOM, vulnerabilities, maintainer and runtime before execution. Lockfiles and trusted publishers prevent substitution and dependency confusion; updates are staged, rescanned, diffed and rollbackable; revoked or newly critical artifacts are quarantined; and offline verification uses retained transparency evidence. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
